chauffeursMobileScreen.title: Chauffeur assigned by Pixkuy
chauffeursMobileScreen.body: Once the booking is confirmed, Pixkuy prepares the transfer with you: assigning the chauffeur, reviewing the trip details and sharing the necessary information through the channel indicated during the request.
chauffeursMobileScreen.imageAlt: Private chauffeur service by Pixkuy with an assigned executive vehicle.

assigned.title: Assigned chauffeur
assigned.text: Before the service, you receive the operational details of the assigned chauffeur so you know who is picking you up and can coordinate the arrival with peace of mind.

operations.title: Pickup prepared
operations.text: We review the time, exact pickup point, access or lobby, flight and terminal when applicable, expected luggage and assigned vehicle.

service.title: Standard behind the wheel
service.text: Calm driving, careful presentation, discretion and attentive service from pickup to destination, with luggage assistance when needed.

privacy.title: Trip data
privacy.text: Booking information is used to prepare the transfer, coordinate the chauffeur and handle any operational adjustment to the service.

documents.title: Reviewed chauffeur
documents.text: Each chauffeur goes through a prior review of valid license, references, employment documentation and background checks before providing service with Pixkuy.

insurance.title: Comprehensive insurance
insurance.text: The assigned vehicle has comprehensive coverage for chauffeur service and passenger transport, including civil liability, occupant coverage and roadside assistance.

chauffeursMobileScreen.closure: Your transfer is coordinated by Pixkuy before the service: assigned chauffeur, reviewed pickup and prior communication with the person making the booking.
